notes.title: Patch (1.063)
notes.content:
Release Date February 22, 2019

Added difficulty selection menu.
On an easy difficulty level, immortal enemies are disabled and will appear only in one of the endings.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.062)
notes.content:
Released October 24, 2018

 Fixed bug due to which the train did not start after loading the saved game.
 Minor fixes for collisions with rails at the second station.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.06)
notes.content:
Released June 21, 2018

Added Simplified Chinese and German to list of localized languages.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.05)
notes.content:
Released June 03, 2018


New atack animations, fight system fixes
Improved player collisions with rats
Running improved
Various bugfixes, including the bug with sleeping while the door to the shelter is open

notes.title: Tunnels of Despair release date
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I sincerily apologize for the another delay of the release. I just had to move the release date, because I could't properly test the changes, added in the last two month and various bugs revealed during the testing.

Change list:

Added notes revealing the lore of the game.
Hunger system rewamped.
Added the ability to send ingame feedback via STOMT system. This would allow to make patches, based on the player feedback.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31322826/e6654adee8f02fb8d3d72329dcf138ae84ade68d.jpg
